exact-enclosing-source-verification.objective: Verify the complete enclosing artifact, funding closure and causal history before deriving authority.

procedures.positive: Open a genuine admitted original and every enclosing funding/history parent independently in both endpoint processes.
procedures.negative: Change one byte; omit a parent; substitute artwork, JSON flags, an unsupported schema or an oversized carrier.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Interrupt storage/import/export between each retained block; reopen the identical original after restart.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Both independent readers derive the same admitted closure and source digest; every mutation refuses before authority or credit.
evidenceToRetain: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.
procedures.retest: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.

finding.remediation: Open an admitted original under production roots; mutate bytes, remove parents and re-open complete closure.

canonical-registry-and-root-binding.objective: Pin the SDK release, registry, ruleset, operation matrix and admitted roots.

procedures.positive: Reproduce the exact build, canonical roots, registry, ruleset and operation matrix from the declared distribution.
procedures.negative: Replace a root, registry, verifier module or resource; run diagnostic custom roots against the production boundary.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Interrupt resource loading and retry with mixed old/new resources.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Actual executable/resource hashes and trust policy match the declared profile; altered or mixed trust material refuses; diagnostic roots never produce production authority.
evidenceToRetain: Reproduce exact resources and independently assess the deployed signer/root policy; custom-root fixtures cannot qualify production.
procedures.retest: Reproduce exact resources and independently assess the deployed signer/root policy; custom-root fixtures cannot qualify production.

finding.remediation: Reproduce exact resources and independently assess the deployed signer/root policy; custom-root fixtures cannot qualify production.

verified-ownership-and-complete-causal-h.objective: Derive current ownership from admitted state and complete causal history.

procedures.positive: Transfer an actually owned source and independently reopen its complete causal ownership chain.
procedures.negative: Use a former owner, stale ownership head, omitted predecessor or a conflicting branch.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Race competing ownership transitions and replay delayed old heads after restart.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Only current admitted ownership authorizes execution; complete causal history survives; competing/old ownership cannot create another lawful successor.
evidenceToRetain: Reopen actual ownership transitions; reject stale heads, former-owner execution, missing history and conflicting branches.
procedures.retest: Reopen actual ownership transitions; reject stale heads, former-owner execution, missing history and conflicting branches.

finding.remediation: Reopen actual ownership transitions; reject stale heads, former-owner execution, missing history and conflicting branches.

explicit-rail-and-denomination.objective: Conserve Reserve USD claims, Settlement Phi and every signed component of a combined Note.

procedures.positive: Run Reserve-only, Settlement-only and combined Note/asset funding, transfer, credit and applicable redemption using admitted sources.
procedures.negative: Change denomination, exact Phi, signed rail, component order or any part/totals; exercise precision and overflow limits.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Race an old quote against repricing; recover an interrupted mixed allocation/refund.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Reserve returns its original fixed-dollar claim/backing, Settlement its exact Phi, composite parts reconcile throughout; repricing never duplicates or invents value.
evidenceToRetain: Qualify Reserve, Settlement and composite independently with admitted sources, repricing, component mutation and exact debit/credit deltas.
procedures.retest: Qualify Reserve, Settlement and composite independently with admitted sources, repricing, component mutation and exact debit/credit deltas.

finding.remediation: Qualify Reserve, Settlement and composite independently with admitted sources, repricing, component mutation and exact debit/credit deltas.

receiver-identity-and-origin-binding.objective: Bind application audience, account, key, origin and current receiver head.

procedures.positive: Use real sender/receiver keys, registered origin/application audience, receiving account and current destination head.
procedures.negative: Substitute account/key/audience/origin/request after review; forward the same completed file to another receiver.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Rotate/revoke membership or change destination head concurrently with consent and execution.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: The complete accepted receipt binds the exact intended receiver and current admissible authority; all substitutions refuse without misdirected credit.
evidenceToRetain: Use actual sender and receiver identities; refuse another account, key, audience, origin and stale receiver head.
procedures.retest: Use actual sender and receiver identities; refuse another account, key, audience, origin and stale receiver head.

finding.remediation: Use actual sender and receiver identities; refuse another account, key, audience, origin and stale receiver head.

qualified-current-custody.objective: Retain admitted non-exportable custody and required attestation; copying source bytes grants no spend authority.

procedures.positive: Enroll and admit the actual non-exportable custody path; consume one exact prepared head into one bound successor.
procedures.negative: Copy source/handle; restore or clone prior state; test backup-eligible credentials, missing/decreased/repeated/unexpected state and invalid attestation.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Crash before/after exact-head retirement and before packaging; restore a pre-send device image; concurrently approve competing successors.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Retired spend authority cannot reactivate; independently verifiable attestation/consumption binds predecessor, receiver, whole value and successor. A counter increment alone is insufficient.
evidenceToRetain: Exercise actual protected exact-head retirement, clone/backup/restore, signed assertions and crash boundaries on each supported device path.
procedures.retest: Exercise actual protected exact-head retirement, clone/backup/restore, signed assertions and crash boundaries on each supported device path.

finding.remediation: Exercise actual protected exact-head retirement, clone/backup/restore, signed assertions and crash boundaries on each supported device path.

exact-source-and-destination-heads.objective: Verify source and destination predecessor heads before atomic commit.

procedures.positive: Commit a complete operation against independently verified exact source and destination heads.
procedures.negative: Change either head, participant set or claimed transition after consent.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Race two genuine operations and inject crash between participant writes on the actual durable adapter.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Every accepted participant transition uses the exact reviewed predecessor; all commit or none; stale/conflicting transitions cannot report success.
evidenceToRetain: Run actual concurrent native executions against stale source and destination heads; inspect complete accepted transitions or authenticated refusal.
procedures.retest: Run actual concurrent native executions against stale source and destination heads; inspect complete accepted transitions or authenticated refusal.

finding.remediation: Run actual concurrent native executions against stale source and destination heads; inspect complete accepted transitions or authenticated refusal.

verified-kaisigil-bound-kks-coordinate.objective: Preserve KaiSigil-bound KKS coordinates and causal order; wall-clock labels are descriptive.

procedures.positive: Verify the actual operation’s carried KaiSigil/KKS proof and predecessor; retain the exact micro-pulse.
procedures.negative: Mutate lattice, BLAKE3/Poseidon commitment, Groth16 signals/proof, predecessor, future bound; substitute bare pulse, local date or Chronos.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Deliver valid operations out of order, replay an old coordinate and reopen the accepted causal chain.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Pinned intrinsic proof verifies; predecessor binding and strict causal progression hold; wall-clock timestamps remain descriptive. No withheld branch is inferred from sorting.
evidenceToRetain: Verify real source-bound KKS coordinates and predecessor order under pinned resources; reject bare timestamp or pulse substitutions.
procedures.retest: Verify real source-bound KKS coordinates and predecessor order under pinned resources; reject bare timestamp or pulse substitutions.

finding.remediation: Verify real source-bound KKS coordinates and predecessor order under pinned resources; reject bare timestamp or pulse substitutions.

explicit-capability-and-exact-operation-.objective: Authorize the exact operation through current participants and scoped capability. Protect private custody and authorization material.

procedures.positive: Review and approve the exact operation under current participant capability and correctly scoped identity.
procedures.negative: Change value/recipient/heads after review; use expired/revoked/foreign capability or serialized handles.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Revoke during pending execution; interrupt signing/retention; inspect actual public caches, logs, telemetry and model exposure.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Accepted operation and consent match exactly; refusal has no unauthorized effect; identity secrets, tokens, attestation and execution custody remain protected.
evidenceToRetain: Qualify real signatures, revocation, expiry and changed terms; audit logs/caches/model access for private keys, tokens, attestation and execution handles.
procedures.retest: Qualify real signatures, revocation, expiry and changed terms; audit logs/caches/model access for private keys, tokens, attestation and execution handles.

finding.remediation: Qualify real signatures, revocation, expiry and changed terms; audit logs/caches/model access for private keys, tokens, attestation and execution handles.

exclusive-value-allocation.objective: Exclude allocated value from all other spendable memberships; public prices cannot create backing.

procedures.positive: Allocate actual admitted value to a Note or asset and independently inspect account, Note, backing and inventory memberships.
procedures.negative: Attempt duplicate allocation from cached balances, public listings, intrinsic quotes, missing backing or another membership.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Race Note issuance, asset funding and account spending against the same original source; recover lost allocation replies.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: One admitted allocation excludes every competing spendable membership; backing remains tied to its source; no simultaneous online and Note/asset availability.
evidenceToRetain: Use admitted account funding and actual native writer to show one allocation, no duplicate online/Note/asset availability and conserved original backing.
procedures.retest: Use admitted account funding and actual native writer to show one allocation, no duplicate online/Note/asset availability and conserved original backing.

finding.remediation: Use admitted account funding and actual native writer to show one allocation, no duplicate online/Note/asset availability and conserved original backing.

atomic-once-only-consumption-and-credit.objective: Consume the exact predecessor and apply the exact recipient credit once, or no accepted success.

procedures.positive: Consume a genuine terminal and verify the complete native recipient credit/private opening and participant states.
procedures.negative: Replay by changed filename, device, recipient or handover; submit forged metadata/HTTP success without canonical credit.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Submit identical and competing claims concurrently, interrupt each irreversible commit boundary, then recover.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: One exact predecessor yields one accepted successor and exact recipient credit. Identical retries resolve the same result; partial consume/credit never appears successful.
evidenceToRetain: Exercise real concurrent, repeated and cross-device claims with one accepted credit; inspect durable participant and global state after interruption.
procedures.retest: Exercise real concurrent, repeated and cross-device claims with one accepted credit; inspect durable participant and global state after interruption.

finding.remediation: Exercise real concurrent, repeated and cross-device claims with one accepted credit; inspect durable participant and global state after interruption.

durable-exact-intent-recovery.objective: Retain exact reviewed intent and coordinates before consequential execution. Resolve ambiguity before retry/replacement.

procedures.positive: Retain exact reviewed intent, candidates and original recovery coordinates before the first consequential request.
procedures.negative: Lose a reply; supply a foreign refusal/recovery, expired write capability or changed operation/recipient/amount.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Crash before retention, staging, submit, commit, reply and packaging; reopen after process/device restart.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Unknown outcomes resolve the same semantic operation before retry/replacement; complete committed recovery reverifies; authenticated zero-write refusal stays bound; no duplicate execution.
evidenceToRetain: Inject lost responses/crashes at every irreversible boundary on the actual durable adapter. Reopen the same accepted original without staging a replacement.
procedures.retest: Inject lost responses/crashes at every irreversible boundary on the actual durable adapter. Reopen the same accepted original without staging a replacement.

finding.remediation: Inject lost responses/crashes at every irreversible boundary on the actual durable adapter. Reopen the same accepted original without staging a replacement.

independent-receipt-and-source-reverific.objective: Independently reopen complete committed source, receipt and exact participant transitions before showing success.

procedures.positive: Independently reopen the full committed source/receipt, source/destination transitions and required private opening.
procedures.negative: Substitute an image label, status boolean, digest, database row, HTTP result, wrong opening or incomplete archive.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Lose receipt delivery after commit, interrupt archive packaging and reopen from a separate process.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Success is reported only after complete canonical verification under the declared policy, with exact accepted heads/amounts; recovery retains complete independent receipt evidence.
evidenceToRetain: Reverify full authentic funding, handover, credit/cancellation and account openings. A digest, HTTP result or caller report is insufficient.
procedures.retest: Reverify full authentic funding, handover, credit/cancellation and account openings. A digest, HTTP result or caller report is insufficient.

finding.remediation: Reverify full authentic funding, handover, credit/cancellation and account openings. A digest, HTTP result or caller report is insufficient.

byte-exact-unknown-namespace-preservatio.objective: Preserve original bytes, unknown namespaces, causal history and recovery through import/export/synchronization.

procedures.positive: Round-trip original source, complete history and an opaque unknown namespace through every supported store/import/export/sync path.
procedures.negative: Reencode/truncate the image, drop unknown fields/namespaces or transport only a property bag.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Interrupt sync and deliver duplicate/out-of-order revisions across separate processes/devices.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Original complete source hashes and unknown namespace bytes survive; canonical reopened history/heads agree. Reopening does not reuse serialized authority handles.
evidenceToRetain: Round-trip actual originals across process/device and transport; compare exact hashes, unknown namespaces and canonical reopened heads.
procedures.retest: Round-trip actual originals across process/device and transport; compare exact hashes, unknown namespaces and canonical reopened heads.

finding.remediation: Round-trip actual originals across process/device and transport; compare exact hashes, unknown namespaces and canonical reopened heads.

immediate-known-local-projection.objective: Paint retained verified state immediately; label freshness accurately and reconcile received value before spending.

procedures.positive: Cold-open the actual supported device offline with retained verified local holdings and received-but-unconfirmed Notes.
procedures.negative: Delay/fail refresh, present stale remote data, reconnect with unconfirmed credit and attempt spending/new Note creation.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Restart during refresh/reconciliation; race old/new reads and identity changes.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Latest known verified local truth paints without an initial network/ceremony; freshness is accurate; no stale overwrite or unconfirmed credit becomes spend authority; reconciliation precedes execution.
evidenceToRetain: Exercise cold/offline first paint, outages, delayed reads and reconnect on actual browser/device. Retention must not create credit or attest successful refresh.
procedures.retest: Exercise cold/offline first paint, outages, delayed reads and reconnect on actual browser/device. Retention must not create credit or attest successful refresh.

finding.remediation: Exercise cold/offline first paint, outages, delayed reads and reconnect on actual browser/device. Retention must not create credit or attest successful refresh.

receiver-specific-live-qualification.objective: Name the exact implementation, capability, rail, source/build, environment, adapter and hardware; publish failures and limits.

procedures.positive: Reproduce the named implementation/build, capabilities, all selected rails, roots, adapter, realm and hardware with an independent reviewer.
procedures.negative: Omit evidence, copy another build’s report or generalize one rail/device/route to untested capabilities.
procedures.concurrencyAndInterruption: Reassess after any material source, trust, adapter/environment or hardware change; reproduce failed cases after remediation.
procedures.acceptanceCriteria: Every applicable control has accepted inspectable evidence and a named reviewer decision. Failures, missing/expired evidence, exclusions and non-applicability rationale remain explicit; no badge or project permission substitutes for proof.
evidenceToRetain: Independent assessment of every applicable invariant with admitted real sources, actual production writer and qualified hardware. Reference checks do not satisfy this gate.
procedures.retest: Independent assessment of every applicable invariant with admitted real sources, actual production writer and qualified hardware. Reference checks do not satisfy this gate.

finding.remediation: Independent assessment of every applicable invariant with admitted real sources, actual production writer and qualified hardware. Reference checks do not satisfy this gate.

conclusion.rationale: Complete every applicable control and retain independently inspectable original evidence before concluding conformance for the exact assessed scope.
